page.title: Card step for Linen washcloth, pair

product.name: Linen washcloth, pair
product.description: The washcloths are linen and sold as a pair.

blocks.text: The form wants the digits on the plastic, the month and year, and the short code on the back.
It does not ask for the sign-in secret of your bank site.
The host in the header is the shop you opened. The tag on Linen washcloth, pair matches the amount due.
No sleeve is ticked. No repeat parcel is marked.
The shelf card lists fourteen on hand in the stockroom.
You are paying Lumenfield at www.lumenfield.example.
